g.text: Threshold income per month marking the poorest decile (after tax)
The level of income per month below which 10% of the population falls. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in
living costs between countries. Income here is measured after taxes and benefits.
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Income has been equivalized.
